column3: A rolled up note is inside the vase. It reads - how many days are in a week.
A handwritten note falls out of the book. It reads - how many strikes to strike out in baseball.
Inside the safe is a journal entry that reads - I have been here for as many years as there are days in a week. Remember this number.
A note is taped to the back of the painting. It reads - how many suits are in a standard deck of cards.
A crumpled note is at the bottom of the bag. It reads - how many seconds are in a minute.
A note inside reads - combine the number from the safe with the suits and seconds you found.
